verdict.rationale: Metorial is an integration platform that connects agents to downstream apps, so event subscriptions (triggers or webhooks) are a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents triggers, webhooks or registrable event subscriptions from connected apps. The material covers only tool-calling sessions, hosted MCP servers, OAuth and observability traces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
